race.title: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden Hurdle
race.verdict: MINELLA MACHINE looked a useful prospect when off the mark in bumpers last season and this costly point recruit is taken to continue the stable’s fine recent record in this race, with fellow expensive pointing purchase Coq Noir feared most now hurdling and likely to leave his sole bumper effort well behind, while unbeaten bumper performer Adaboy Mushy must also enter calculations. MINELLA MACHINE (IRE) COQ NOIR (FR) ADABOY MUSHY (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Minella Machine (2/1), Adaboy Mushy (7/2), Got The Honours (4/1), Coq Noir (6/1), Claude Du Val (7/1), Muckanagh Lough (8/1), Straight Bourbon (33/1), Gold Star Status (50/1), No Loose Ends (66/1), Marine Tycoon (66/1), Barrow Side Boy (100/1)
